import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from pathlib import Path

meta=json.load(open('inputs.json'))
raw=np.load('neural_inputs.npz')

def preprocess(x,sigma=0.8):
    x=gaussian_filter1d(x.astype(float),sigma,axis=0)
    return x / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-9)

arrays={k:preprocess(raw[k]) for k in raw.files}

def dtw(a,b):
    C=cdist(a,b,'cosine')
    n,m=C.shape
    D=np.full((n+1,m+1),np.inf); D[0,0]=0
    P=np.zeros((n,m),np.int8)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            v=[D[i,j],D[i,j+1]+0.12,D[i+1,j]+0.12]
            p=np.argmin(v)
            D[i+1,j+1]=C[i,j]+v[p]; P[i,j]=p
    i,j=n-1,m-1; path=[]
    while i>=0 and j>=0:
        path.append((i,j))
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0:i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1:i-=1
        else:j-=1
    path=path[::-1]
    return D[n,m]/len(path),path,C

if __name__=='__main__':
    out={}
    for q in meta['queries']:
        qid=q['id']; rows=[]
        for c in meta['calibration']:
            score,path,C=dtw(arrays[qid],arrays[c['id']])
            rows.append({'id':c['id'],'tokens':c['tokens'],'score':score,'path':path})
        rows.sort(key=lambda r:r['score']);out[qid]=rows
        print('\n',qid)
        for r in rows[:12]:print(round(r['score'],4),r['id'],' '.join(r['tokens']))
    Path('global_retrieval.json').write_text(json.dumps(out))

def subsequence(a,b,penalty=.035):
 S=a@b.T;n,m=S.shape
 D=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9);D[0,:]=0
 P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
 for i in range(1,n+1):
  for j in range(1,m+1):
   cand=[D[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]]
   cand.append(D[i-2,j-1]+S[i-2,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]-penalty if i>=2 else -1e9)
   cand.append(D[i-1,j-2]+.5*(S[i-1,j-2]+S[i-1,j-1])-penalty if j>=2 else -1e9)
   p=np.argmax(cand);D[i,j]=cand[p];P[i,j]=p
 j=np.argmax(D[n,:]);score=D[n,j]/n;end=int(j);i=n;path=[]
 while i>0:
  p=P[i,j];path.append((i-1,j-1))
  if p==0:i-=1;j-=1
  elif p==1:path.append((i-2,j-1));i-=2;j-=1
  else:path.append((i-1,j-2));i-=1;j-=2
 return {'similarity':float(score),'start':int(j),'end':end,'path':path[::-1]}

from retrieval import *
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d

def make_arrays(tag):
 p=np.load('unsupervised_pca.npz');w=p['eigenvalues'];v=p['eigenvectors'];mu=p['mean']
 weights=np.ones(raw[meta['calibration'][0]['id']].shape[1])
 if tag=='drop2':weights[:2]=0
 elif tag=='white':weights=1/np.maximum(w,1)**.5
 elif tag=='pca64drop2':weights[:2]=0;weights[64:]=0
 elif tag=='pca32drop2':weights[:2]=0;weights[32:]=0
 elif tag=='raw':pass
 A={}
 for k in raw.files:
  x=gaussian_filter1d((raw[k]-mu)@v*weights,1.2,axis=0)
  A[k]=x/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-9)
 return A

def interval_vector(a,s,e,n=8):
 # interpolate each normalized trajectory and retain temporal shape
 t=np.linspace(s,e-1,n);lo=np.floor(t).astype(int);hi=np.minimum(lo+1,len(a)-1);alpha=(t-lo)[:,None]
 x=a[lo]*(1-alpha)+a[hi]*alpha
 return (x/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-9)).ravel()/np.sqrt(n)

def retrieve(tag):
 A=make_arrays(tag);cand=[];V=[]
 for c in meta['calibration']:
  a=A[c['id']]
  for length in range(4,19):
   for start in range(2,len(a)-length-1):
    cand.append((c['id'],start,start+length));V.append(interval_vector(a,start,start+length))
 V=np.asarray(V,dtype=np.float32)
 out={}
 for q in meta['queries']:
  a=A[q['id']];rows=[];vec=[]
  for length in [5,8,11,15]:
   for start in range(2,len(a)-length-1,3):
    rows.append((start,start+length));vec.append(interval_vector(a,start,start+length))
  sims=np.asarray(vec,dtype=np.float32)@V.T
  qr=[]
  for r,sim in zip(rows,sims):
   ix=np.argsort(sim)[-150:][::-1];seen=set();matches=[]
   for j in ix:
    cid,s,e=cand[j]
    if cid in seen:continue
    seen.add(cid);matches.append({'id':cid,'start':s,'end':e,'similarity':float(sim[j])})
    if len(matches)==10:break
   qr.append({'start':r[0],'end':r[1],'matches':matches})
  out[q['id']]=qr
 Path('local_'+tag+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(out))
 print('wrote',tag,flush=True)

def edge_match(a,b,penalty=.035):
 S=a@b.T;n,m=S.shape
 D=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9);D[0,0]=0
 for i in range(1,n+1):
  for j in range(1,m+1):
   cand=[D[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]]
   cand.append(D[i-2,j-1]+S[i-2,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]-penalty if i>=2 else -1e9)
   cand.append(D[i-1,j-2]+.5*(S[i-1,j-2]+S[i-1,j-1])-penalty if j>=2 else -1e9)
   D[i,j]=max(cand)
 j=np.argmax(D[n,:]);return float(D[n,j]/n),int(j)
